relationships.subject: Neuropathic pain
relationships.evidence_quote: NP activated NF-κB/NLRP3 inflammasome pathways by upregulating NF-κB, NLRP3, ASC, active Caspase-1

relationships.subject: Melatonin
relationships.evidence_quote: MLT could promote cell survival from apoptosis by modulating Bax and Bcl2

key_findings: CCI neuropathic pain upregulated NF-κB, NLRP3, ASC, Caspase-1, IL-1β and IL-18 in hippocampus and prefrontal cortex; melatonin reversed this and reduced apoptosis and pain/mood behaviors.
